title: Non-Abelian and Type-A Conformal Anomalies from Euler Descent
summary: We classify the non-Abelian anomaly of the Euclidean conformal group $SO(2n+1,1)$ in $2n$ dimensions via Stora-Zumino descent from its Euler invariant polynomial in $2n+2$ dimensions. In this way, we place the conformal anomaly on the same footing as ordinary perturbative 't Hooft anomalies. We also explore the relation of the non-Abelian anomaly to the known \textit{type-A Weyl anomaly}, which involves projecting into a Weyl cocycle.
